subject: 🏃 Friday — Stability & Power + PT Follow-Up (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: Stability & Power at Cañada College — and your PT follow-up with Akanksha. The PT appointment is the bigger event. Whatever she says overrides the plan, so be upfront about the full picture: you've been running 6–8 mi including threshold work, heavy squatting 155 lb, and the knee has been 1/5 across every V6 session.

Warm-up: Foam roll quads/IT band 1 min each → 90/90 PAILs 30 sec each side → banded lateral walks 10 each direction → Spanish squat hold 30 sec → Copenhagen plank 20 sec each side.

ExerciseWeightDose
Bulgarian split squat20 lb/hand3×10 each side
Single-leg RDL (contralateral)25 lb single3×10 each side
Spanish squat holdLight band3×30–45 sec
Copenhagen plankBW3×30 sec each
Side plank w/ hip abd (PT)BW8 reps each, top toe down
Dead bug w/ banded pulldown (PT)Light band2–3×10 slow marches
Chin tuck + lifts (PT)BW2 reps each dir, 3-sec hold

SL-RDL note: Bumping from 20 to 25 lb contralateral — W1 rated Easy at 20. Stay single-hand; the anti-rotation challenge is the whole point.

Focus cue: Copenhagen plank — drive the adductor hard into the bench, keep hips stacked, don't let the top hip roll forward. You're at 30 sec/side; if that feels controlled today, push to 35.

Context: Week 2 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — 10 weeks to race day. Wednesday's heavy session was clean at full Rx, Thursday's progression run nailed the HR-first protocol (19:30 in Z4, knee 1/5). You're in a strong position heading into Bay to Breakers Sunday.

Looking ahead: Saturday is a light 5K shakeout at 9:30+ pace — just flushing the legs. Prep your 3 Maurten gels tonight (one-handed dry-tear test on each pouch — set aside any that don't open clean). Get to bed by 10.
